born: c. 296/298, Alexandria (background, not read in a source in this run; approximate)
died: 2 May 373, Alexandria (background, not read in a source in this run)
role_place: Bishop of Alexandria (328–373); defender of the Nicene homoousios against the Arians (background; the Nicene and Arian context is confirmed in the texts read)
why_relevant: Hist. Arian. §33 and §67 say the Arian party's use of force in matters of faith is alien to Christ and that true godliness does not compel but persuades (N); but in De Decretis 28 he asks, rhetorically, who would not stone such 'madmen' (X), and Apol. ad Const. 30 quotes an imperial letter ordering executions of his own clergy (X, quoted opponent).

Only 459 x 309 px exists on Commons, below the 800-1200 px target; it is the only size available. Athanasius is not clearly identifiable from the image itself (no halo visible at this size), so the caption is the uploader's identification.
